user.title: Climate Template
user.description: Configure your climate entity using entity selectors and optional action scripts.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this climate entity.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Select a temperature sensor to monitor.
data_description.heater: Entity that controls heating (switch, input_boolean, etc.).
data_description.cooler: Optional: Entity for cooling in Heat/Cool mode.
data_description.ac_mode: Enable if heater is an AC unit (inverts control logic).
data_description.hvac_modes: Select which HVAC modes to enable.
data_description.humidity_sensor: Select a humidity sensor to display current humidity.
data_description.hvac_mode_entity: Entity that represents HVAC mode (input_select, select).
data_description.fan_mode_entity: Entity to send fan speed commands to (input_select, select, fan).
data_description.preset_mode_entity: Entity to send preset mode commands to (input_select, select).
data_description.swing_mode_entity: Entity to send swing commands to (input_select, select, switch).
data_description.swing_horizontal_mode_entity: Entity to send horizontal swing commands to.
data_description.target_temperature_entity: Entity to sync target temperature with (input_number, number). Enables TX/RX.
data_description.humidity_entity: Entity to send target humidity commands to (input_number, number).
data_description.set_temperature: Optional: Action script override for temperature changes.
data_description.set_hvac_mode: Optional: Action script override for HVAC mode changes.
data_description.set_fan_mode: Optional: Action script override for fan mode changes.
data_description.set_preset_mode: Optional: Action script override for preset mode changes.
data_description.set_swing_mode: Optional: Action script override for swing mode changes.
data_description.set_swing_horizontal_mode: Optional: Action script override for horizontal swing changes.
data_description.set_humidity: Optional: Action script override for humidity changes.

error.min_max_error: Min temp must be less than max temp.
error.no_hvac_modes: At least one HVAC mode required.
error.heater_or_cooler_required: At least one of Heater or Cooler entity must be provided.
